DISCUSSION ITEM

Friday, August 25, 2023  2
 1.  SUBJECT:  RATIFICATION OF PROCLAMATION OF COUNTY-WIDE LOCAL
  EMERGENCY (UNINCORPORATED AND INCORPORATED AREAS
  OF SAN DIEGO COUNTY) REGARDING IMPACTS OF TROPICAL
  STORM HILARY (DISTRICTS: ALL)

  OVERVIEW
  On August 19, 2023, the Chief Administrative Officer of the County of San Diego as Director of
  Emergency Services, issued a Proclamation of Local Emergency in anticipation of regionwide
  impacts associated with Tropical Storm Hilary. Potential impacts were forecasted to include
  flooding, erosion, coastal storm surge, and storm debris throughout the County and a potential
  for road closures and damage to both public and private infrastructure. The Proclamation was
  issued pursuant to San Diego County Code of Regulatory Ordinances sections 31.101 et seq. and
  California Government Code Section 8630. The Local Proclamation followed a State
  Proclamation of Emergency issued by Governor Newsom for parts of the State of California,
  including San Diego County.

  This is a request for the Board of Supervisors to ratify the Proclamation and find that there is a
  need for continuing the local emergency until no longer needed subject to statutory review
  requirements.

  RECOMMENDATION(S)
  CHIEF ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER
  1. Ratify the attached PROCLAMATION OF EXISTENCE OF A COUNTY-WIDE LOCAL
  EMERGENCY (UNINCORPORATED AND INCORPORATED AREAS OF SAN DIEGO
  COUNTY) made by the Chief Administrative Officer of the County of San Diego as Director of
  Emergency Services on August 19, 2023.

  2. Find that there is a need for continuing the local emergency until otherwise determined,
  subject to Government Code 8630 review requirements.

  EQUITY IMPACT STATEMENT
  The recommendations to ratify the attached Proclamation of Local Emergency made by the
  Chief Administrative Officer of the County of San Diego as Director of Emergency Services on
  August 19, 2023, subject to Government Code 8630 review requirements, advocates for and
  protects the health and wellbeing of everyone in the region.

  SUSTAINABILITY IMPACT STATEMENT
  The proposed actions to ratify the attached Proclamation of Local Emergency made by the Chief
  Administrative Officer as the Director of Emergency Services on August 19, 2023 and find that
  there is a need for continuing the local emergency until no longer needed, subject to Government
  Code 8630 review requirements, contribute to the County of San Diego’s Sustainability Goals by
  efficiently serving and reinforcing healthy communities, responding to natural disaster related
  emergencies, remediating environmental harms, and promoting safe governmental practices.
  This will also assist with ensuring the capability to respond and recover to immediate needs for
  individuals, families, and the region.

Friday, August 25, 2023  1
   FISCAL IMPACT
  There is no fiscal impact associated with these recommendations. There will be no change in net
  General Fund cost and no additional staff years. Staff will return to the Board for consideration
  and approval of additional fiscal impacts associated with the recommendations if needed.

  BUSINESS IMPACT STATEMENT
  N/A
